about: Generated concept imagery for Monolith Sports (Kie AI, Flux-2 Pro; film: Veo 3.1). Every frame is a visual concept of a product type, not a photograph of Monolith's own products or premises: no factories, staff or people are generated. Replace each with the client's own photography as it is shot (docs/CONTENT-CHECKLIST.md). Run: node scripts/generate-media.mjs [--only id,id] [--video].
style: Commercial studio product photograph for a premium sports equipment manufacturer, shot on a medium-format camera with a 100mm lens at f/8, every part of the product in crisp focus. Low-key lighting: one large softbox from the upper left, a narrow strip light behind for a clean rim, a deep charcoal seamless backdrop (#141414) falling off to near black, the product resting on a matte black surface with a soft contact shadow. Neutral true-to-life colour, gentle contrast, fine material texture visible, realistic construction and accurate real-world proportions. Every surface of the product is plain and unbranded: no printed or embossed words, letters, numbers, logos, symbols, tags, labels or watermarks anywhere in the image. No people, no hands, no faces.

film.prompt: Slow, smooth cinematic camera move: the camera glides in a gentle arc around the football resting on the dark carbon-fibre floor while the ball turns slowly on the spot, dust particles drift through the single beam of light, the rim light traces the stitched seams, the background stays near black. Calm, premium, no cuts, no text, no people.
